# Kpstn Studios

> Kpstn Studios makes Android games and apps on Google Play: Tiny Courier, a relaxing 3D puzzle game; No Paddle, a sailing boat game; and Scanaria, an OCR app and document scanner. Three more games are on the way.

All three apps are on Google Play for Android, and none needs an account. Each page below has the full details and a "Good to know" section that answers common questions.

## Games and apps

- [Tiny Courier](https://kapstn-studios.github.io/tiny-courier/): A calm, cozy 3D logic puzzle game. A little walking mailbox has parcels to deliver: turn floating clay islands, slide bridges, ride lifts and bring every parcel to the pad of its colour. 460 levels in 7 worlds, no timers, no lives, hints and undo, colour-blind friendly, and the puzzles play offline. Free to download. The first 20 levels have no ads; after that a short ad plays now and then between levels, never in the middle of a puzzle and never as a banner.
- [No Paddle](https://kapstn-studios.github.io/no-paddle/): A sailing boat game about reading the wind, between a sailing game and a light sailing simulator. Your oar is gone, so tack upwind, trim the sail and sail home past reefs, whirlpools, storms and pirates. 110 voyages across 11 worlds, regattas against three rival boats, a new Daily Voyage every day and five boats up to a three-masted galleon. Free to download, supported by ads, with no in-app purchases.
- [Scanaria](https://kapstn-studios.github.io/scanaria/): An OCR app and document scanner. Image to text with on-device OCR (Latin, Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese and Korean scripts), scan to searchable PDF, edit PDFs, translate scanned text, scan and make QR codes, and ask questions about your documents with a language model that runs on the phone. Text scanning works offline; translation and the AI assistant need a one-time download. Photos and scans are processed on the phone and not uploaded. All features are currently free.

## Get them on Google Play

- [Tiny Courier on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.manpreetgugga.tinycourier&referrer=utm_source%3Dllms_txt%26utm_medium%3Dai)
- [No Paddle: Sailing Boat Game on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.github.manpreetgugga.boatify&referrer=utm_source%3Dllms_txt%26utm_medium%3Dai)
- [Scanaria on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.manpreet.fileocr&referrer=utm_source%3Dllms_txt%26utm_medium%3Dai)
- [All apps by Kpstn Studios on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Kpstn+Studios)

## Coming soon

- Low Gear: a little red delivery truck, a full bed of parcels and one control, the brake. One-thumb driving across 5 routes.
- Boomlets: help Pip drop fizzy pods, blast crates and outsmart critters across 25 floating worlds, each with its own twist and a boss at the end.
- Paper Town (in development): a folded paper letter crosses a pop-up book of paper worlds, refolding into origami shapes to get past whatever blocks the way. A 3D adventure.
